mapper.sql: A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.NOTICE_ID AS noticeId , A.TITLE AS title , A.CONTENT AS content , A.TARGET_SCOPE AS targetScope , A.INCLUDE_DAILY_YN AS includeDailyYn , A.POPUP_YN AS popupYn , A.POPUP_FROM_YMD AS popupFromYmd , A.POPUP_TO_YMD AS popupToYmd , A.PIN_YN AS pinYn , A.PIN_ORDER AS pinOrder , A.INSERT_NO AS insertNo , DATE_FORMAT(A.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS insertDate , U.USER_NM AS insertUserNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.UPDATE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updateDate
mapper.select:
/* Notice01Mapper.selectNoticeOne */ SELECT
, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_NOTICE_FILE NF WHERE NF.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND NF.NOTICE_ID = A.NOTICE_ID ) AS fileCnt , CASE WHEN K.LAST_READ_DATE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isUnread , CASE WHEN K.LAST_READ_DATE IS NOT NULL AND A.UPDATE_DATE IS NOT NULL AND A.UPDATE_DATE > K.LAST_READ_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isUpdated , NULL AS targetSummary FROM TB_NOTICE A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_USER U ON U.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND U.USER_CD = A.INSERT_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_NOTICE_USER_ACK K ON K.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND K.NOTICE_ID = A.NOTICE_ID AND K.USER_CD = #{gvUserCd} WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId} AND A.NOTICE_TYPE = 'NOTICE' AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'

/* Notice01Mapper.selectNoticeFileList */ SELECT NF.FILE_MGMT_CD AS fileMgmtCd , FI.FILE_NM AS fileNm , FI.FILE_EXT AS fileExt , FI.FILE_PATH AS filePath , NF.SORT_IDX AS sortIdx FROM TB_NOTICE_FILE NF INNER JOIN TB_FILE_INFO FI ON FI.CMPNY_CD = NF.CMPNY_CD AND FI.FILE_MGMT_CD = NF.FILE_MGMT_CD WHERE NF.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND NF.NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId} ORDER BY NF.SORT_IDX ASC, NF.FILE_MGMT_CD ASC

/* Notice01Mapper.selectNoticeTargetList */ SELECT T.TARGET_SEQ AS targetSeq , T.SITE_CD AS siteCd , S.SITE_NM AS siteNm , T.NODE_CD AS nodeCd , N.NODE_NM AS nodeNm , T.INCLUDE_DESCENDANTS_YN AS includeDescendantsYn FROM TB_NOTICE_TARGET T LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE S ON S.CMPNY_CD = T.CMPNY_CD AND S.SITE_CD = T.SITE_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE_NODE N ON N.CMPNY_CD = T.CMPNY_CD AND N.SITE_CD = T.SITE_CD AND N.NODE_CD = T.NODE_CD WHERE T.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND T.NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId} ORDER BY T.TARGET_SEQ ASC

/* Notice01Mapper.selectNextNoticeId */ SELECT CONCAT( 'N' , DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d') , LPAD( IFNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBSTR(A.NOTICE_ID, 10, 3) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) + 1 , 3, '0' ) ) FROM TB_NOTICE A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.NOTICE_TYPE = 'NOTICE' AND A.NOTICE_ID LIKE CONCAT('N', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), '%')

/* Notice01Mapper.selectNoticeForUpdate */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.NOTICE_ID AS noticeId , A.TITLE AS title , A.CONTENT AS content , A.TARGET_SCOPE AS targetScope , A.INCLUDE_DAILY_YN AS includeDailyYn , A.POPUP_YN AS popupYn , A.POPUP_FROM_YMD AS popupFromYmd , A.POPUP_TO_YMD AS popupToYmd , A.PIN_YN AS pinYn , A.PIN_ORDER AS pinOrder , A.INSERT_NO AS insertNo , DATE_FORMAT(A.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS insertDate , NULL AS insertUserNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.UPDATE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updateDate , 0 AS fileCnt , 0 AS isUnread , 0 AS isUpdated , NULL AS targetSummary FROM TB_NOTICE A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId} AND A.NOTICE_TYPE = 'NOTICE' AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: /* Notice01Mapper.compactPinOrder */ UPDATE TB_NOTICE TGT INNER JOIN ( SELECT R.NOTICE_ID , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY R.PIN_ORDER ASC, R.INSERT_DATE DESC) AS RN FROM TB_NOTICE R WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND R.NOTICE_TYPE = 'NOTICE' AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' AND R.PIN_YN = 'Y' ) SEQ ON SEQ.NOTICE_ID = TGT.NOTICE_ID SET TGT.PIN_ORDER = SEQ.RN WHERE TGT.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd}
mapper.select:
/* Notice01Mapper.selectScopeSiteNodeTree */
SELECT 'SITE' AS level , S.SITE_CD AS siteCd , S.SITE_NM AS siteNm , NULL AS nodeCd , NULL AS nodeNm , NULL AS parentNodeCd FROM TB_SITE S WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} UNION ALL SELECT 'NODE' AS level , N.SITE_CD AS siteCd , NULL AS siteNm , N.NODE_CD AS nodeCd , N.NODE_NM AS nodeNm , N.PARENT_NODE_CD AS parentNodeCd FROM TB_SITE_NODE N WHERE N.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} ORDER BY level DESC, siteCd, parentNodeCd, nodeCd
WITH RECURSIVE auth_site AS (
SELECT DISTINCT US.SITE_CD FROM TB_USER_SITE_AUTH US WHERE US.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND US.USER_CD = #{gvUserCd} AND US.USE_YN = 'Y'
UNION SELECT #{gvSiteCd} AS SITE_CD
), self_subtree AS (
SELECT N.CMPNY_CD, N.SITE_CD, N.NODE_CD, N.NODE_NM, N.PARENT_NODE_CD FROM TB_SITE_NODE N WHERE N.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND N.SITE_CD = #{gvSiteCd} AND N.NODE_CD = #{gvNodeCd}
AND 1 = 0
UNION ALL SELECT C.CMPNY_CD, C.SITE_CD, C.NODE_CD, C.NODE_NM, C.PARENT_NODE_CD FROM TB_SITE_NODE C INNER JOIN self_subtree P ON C.CMPNY_CD = P.CMPNY_CD AND C.SITE_CD = P.SITE_CD AND C.PARENT_NODE_CD = P.NODE_CD )
SELECT 'SITE' AS level , S.SITE_CD AS siteCd , S.SITE_NM AS siteNm , NULL AS nodeCd , NULL AS nodeNm , NULL AS parentNodeCd FROM TB_SITE S INNER JOIN auth_site A2 ON A2.SITE_CD = S.SITE_CD WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} UNION ALL
SELECT 'NODE' AS level , N.SITE_CD AS siteCd , NULL AS siteNm , N.NODE_CD AS nodeCd , N.NODE_NM AS nodeNm , N.PARENT_NODE_CD AS parentNodeCd FROM TB_SITE_NODE N INNER JOIN auth_site A3 ON A3.SITE_CD = N.SITE_CD WHERE N.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND ( #{gvSiteCd} IS NULL OR N.SITE_CD != #{gvSiteCd} ) UNION ALL
SELECT 'NODE' AS level , T.SITE_CD AS siteCd , NULL AS siteNm , T.NODE_CD AS nodeCd , T.NODE_NM AS nodeNm , T.PARENT_NODE_CD AS parentNodeCd FROM self_subtree T

/* Notice01Mapper.selectPopupNoticeList */ SELECT N.NOTICE_ID AS noticeId , N.TITLE AS title , N.CONTENT AS content , N.PIN_YN AS pinYn , N.POPUP_FROM_YMD AS popupFromYmd , N.POPUP_TO_YMD AS popupToYmd , DATE_FORMAT(N.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS insertDate , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_NOTICE_FILE NF WHERE NF.CMPNY_CD = N.CMPNY_CD AND NF.NOTICE_ID = N.NOTICE_ID ) AS fileCnt , 10 AS isDaily FROM TB_NOTICE N WHERE N.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND N.NOTICE_TYPE = 'NOTICE' AND N.DEL_YN = 'N' AND N.POPUP_YN = 'Y' AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN N.POPUP_FROM_YMD AND N.POPUP_TO_YMD
AND N.INCLUDE_DAILY_YN = 'Y' AND ( N.TARGET_SCOPE = 'ALL' OR ( N.TARGET_SCOPE = 'SITE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_NOTICE_TARGET T WHERE T.CMPNY_CD = N.CMPNY_CD AND T.NOTICE_ID = N.NOTICE_ID AND T.SITE_CD = #{curSiteCd} AND T.NODE_CD IS NULL ) ) )
AND ( N.TARGET_SCOPE = 'ALL' OR ( N.TARGET_SCOPE = 'SITE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_NOTICE_TARGET T WHERE T.CMPNY_CD = N.CMPNY_CD AND T.NOTICE_ID = N.NOTICE_ID AND T.SITE_CD = #{curSiteCd} AND T.NODE_CD IS NULL ) ) OR ( N.TARGET_SCOPE = 'NODE' AND EXISTS (
SELECT 1 FROM TB_NOTICE_TARGET T WHERE T.CMPNY_CD = N.CMPNY_CD AND T.NOTICE_ID = N.NOTICE_ID AND T.SITE_CD = #{curSiteCd} AND ( T.NODE_CD = #{curNodeCd} OR ( T.INCLUDE_DESCENDANTS_YN = 'Y' AND EXISTS ( WITH RECURSIVE desc_tree AS ( SELECT DN.CMPNY_CD, DN.SITE_CD, DN.NODE_CD FROM TB_SITE_NODE DN WHERE DN.CMPNY_CD = N.CMPNY_CD AND DN.SITE_CD = T.SITE_CD AND DN.NODE_CD = T.NODE_CD UNION ALL SELECT DC.CMPNY_CD, DC.SITE_CD, DC.NODE_CD FROM TB_SITE_NODE DC INNER JOIN desc_tree DP ON DC.CMPNY_CD = DP.CMPNY_CD AND DC.SITE_CD = DP.SITE_CD AND DC.PARENT_NODE_CD = DP.NODE_CD ) SELECT 1 FROM desc_tree DT WHERE DT.NODE_CD = #{curNodeCd} ) ) ) ) ) )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_NOTICE_USER_ACK A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = N.CMPNY_CD AND A.NOTICE_ID = N.NOTICE_ID AND A.USER_CD = #{gvUserCd} AND A.ACK_TYPE = 'SNOOZED' AND A.SNOOZE_UNTIL_YMD >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d') )
AND ( N.PIN_YN = 'Y' OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_NOTICE_USER_ACK A2 WHERE A2.CMPNY_CD = N.CMPNY_CD AND A2.NOTICE_ID = N.NOTICE_ID AND A2.USER_CD = #{gvUserCd} AND A2.ACK_TYPE = 'CONFIRMED' ) ) ORDER BY N.PIN_YN DESC, N.PIN_ORDER ASC, N.INSERT_DATE DESC LIMIT 10

/* Notice01Mapper.countNoticeVisibleToUser */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_NOTICE N WHERE N.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND N.NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId} AND N.NOTICE_TYPE = 'NOTICE' AND N.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND N.INCLUDE_DAILY_YN = 'Y' AND ( N.TARGET_SCOPE = 'ALL' OR ( N.TARGET_SCOPE = 'SITE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_NOTICE_TARGET T WHERE T.CMPNY_CD = N.CMPNY_CD AND T.NOTICE_ID = N.NOTICE_ID AND T.SITE_CD = #{curSiteCd} AND T.NODE_CD IS NULL ) ) )
AND ( N.TARGET_SCOPE = 'ALL' OR ( N.TARGET_SCOPE = 'SITE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_NOTICE_TARGET T WHERE T.CMPNY_CD = N.CMPNY_CD AND T.NOTICE_ID = N.NOTICE_ID AND T.SITE_CD = #{curSiteCd} AND T.NODE_CD IS NULL ) ) OR ( N.TARGET_SCOPE = 'NODE' AND EXISTS (
SELECT 1 FROM TB_NOTICE_TARGET T WHERE T.CMPNY_CD = N.CMPNY_CD AND T.NOTICE_ID = N.NOTICE_ID AND T.SITE_CD = #{curSiteCd} AND ( T.NODE_CD = #{curNodeCd} OR ( T.INCLUDE_DESCENDANTS_YN = 'Y' AND EXISTS ( WITH RECURSIVE desc_tree AS ( SELECT DN.CMPNY_CD, DN.SITE_CD, DN.NODE_CD FROM TB_SITE_NODE DN WHERE DN.CMPNY_CD = N.CMPNY_CD AND DN.SITE_CD = T.SITE_CD AND DN.NODE_CD = T.NODE_CD UNION ALL SELECT DC.CMPNY_CD, DC.SITE_CD, DC.NODE_CD FROM TB_SITE_NODE DC INNER JOIN desc_tree DP ON DC.CMPNY_CD = DP.CMPNY_CD AND DC.SITE_CD = DP.SITE_CD AND DC.PARENT_NODE_CD = DP.NODE_CD ) SELECT 1 FROM desc_tree DT WHERE DT.NODE_CD = #{curNodeCd} ) ) ) ) ) )

/* Notice01Mapper.selectNoticeFileOne */ SELECT NF.FILE_MGMT_CD AS fileMgmtCd , FI.FILE_NM AS fileNm , FI.FILE_EXT AS fileExt , FI.FILE_PATH AS filePath , NF.SORT_IDX AS sortIdx FROM TB_NOTICE_FILE NF INNER JOIN TB_FILE_INFO FI ON FI.CMPNY_CD = NF.CMPNY_CD AND FI.FILE_MGMT_CD = NF.FILE_MGMT_CD INNER JOIN TB_NOTICE N ON N.CMPNY_CD = NF.CMPNY_CD AND N.NOTICE_ID = NF.NOTICE_ID AND N.NOTICE_TYPE = 'NOTICE' AND N.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE NF.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND NF.NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId} AND NF.FILE_MGMT_CD = #{fileMgmtCd}
mapper.delete: /* Notice01Mapper.deleteExpiredNoticeAck */ DELETE A FROM TB_NOTICE_USER_ACK A INNER JOIN TB_NOTICE N ON N.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND N.NOTICE_ID = A.NOTICE_ID WHERE N.NOTICE_TYPE = 'NOTICE' AND N.POPUP_YN = 'Y' AND N.POPUP_TO_YMD IS NOT NULL AND N.POPUP_TO_YMD < #{cutoffYmd}
